During my studies at ISSEA, I took part in two household surveys in Yaoundé: first as an interviewer, then as a supervisor. They taught me where survey data comes from, and how much its quality depends on the work in the field.

## Survey Supervisor · May 2025 {#supervisor}

- Supervised interviewers during data collection.
- Ran consistency checks on the questionnaires.
- Validated the collected data.

## Survey Interviewer · May 2024 {#interviewer}

- Conducted face-to-face interviews with households for a survey on urban safety in Yaoundé.
